  Two floors, both printed: F_cell = the card's B pair (B_rep - B_s0) per cell, and F_U = |UE_s1 - UE_s0| on the headline cell TAC-LAT.  F2 = max(F_cell, F_U).
  DILUTION-CONFIRMED-2SEED: UM - UE separated better (lower bound above 0) at BOTH seeds, mean of the two deltas >= F2, UM - BL not separated worse at either seed.
  DILUTION-PARTIAL-2SEED: separated better at both seeds, mean below F2 (or UM - BL separated worse at one seed).   DILUTION-ONE-SEED: separated better at exactly one seed.   DILUTION-NULL-2SEED: at neither seed.
  Prediction H per seed: UM - UE in [+0.04, +0.10] and UM - BL not separated worse.   A cell is a two-seed COST only when it is a COST at both seeds; a one-seed cost is printed as one.
